Subject: Planning our Zephyr exec immersion (onsite + hybrid) — draft windows and asks

Marcus — thanks again for the quick intro call last week. Were ready to lock dates for the two-day exec immersion in May and want to align on the "final mile" logistics: arrival windows, on-site liaison, AV dry-run and a short arrival briefing for our execs.

High level:
- Preferred workshop dates: May 15-16 (flexible by +/- 2 days)
- Attendee mix: 6 Zephyr execs (US east), 3 product leads (EU), 4 engineers (APAC dialing in)
- Goal: full-day in-person on Day 1 for leadership \u2014 Day 2 mix of breakout sessions and customer Q/A (hybrid)

Can you send a draft of:
1) suggested 90/120-minute session windows that bridge US/EU/APAC (wed like to avoid deep-overnights for APAC)
2) proposed on-site staffing (Redwood lead + local liaison) and arrival brief (30min) timing
3) hotel block and travel ETA guidance for our execs (theyll fly in from BOS / LHR)

Attached: attendee list (names, dietary, travel constraints). We also expect procurement to loop on contracts/hotel invoice routing.

Thanks — Priya
Priya Menon
VP, Customer Success | Zephyr Systems

Priya thanks for the attendee details, that helps. Draft below  I kept things conservative to minimize overnight windows for APAC while giving EU a late morning slot.

Draft session windows (all local times shown with UTC offsets):
- Day 1 (Leadership): 09:00-10:30 PT / 12:00-13:30 ET / 17:00-18:30 BST (works for LHR dialing after lunch)
- Day 1 (Customer deep-dive): 14:00-16:00 PT / 17:00-19:00 ET / 22:00-00:00 SGT (APAC can join late-evening; we can rotate headcount to cover)
- Day 2 (Breakouts): staggered 08:30-11:00 PT and 13:00-16:00 PT to cover different attendee sets

On-site staffing
- Redwood lead: Marcus Lin (onsite day 1 AM / hybrid day 2)
- Onsite liaison (local): Vanessa Ortiz (venue logistics + AV champion)
- Technical shadow / demo: Logan Wright (setup, KV/priority routing demos)
- Ops backup: Grace O'Connor (travel & rooming triage)

Arrival briefing
- 30-minute arrival brief recommended 60-90 minutes before Day 1 opening (well run AV check, run of show, and exec Q/A prep)

Logistics:
- Ive attached a proposed schedule ICS (proposed_schedule_v1.ics) and a venue floorplan were recommending (venue_floorplan.pdf).
- For hotel block: we can provide a recommended list + a PDF with room block details (hotel_block_details.pdf) for procurement to route to accounts payable.

Next steps
- Please confirm preferred date (May 15/16 or alternate). If confirmed, Ill send calendar holds for proposed windows and a short arrival-brief invite for the internal leads.
- Let me know any hard constraints for APAC (max late start time) and any visa/ground travel requests.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Customer Solutions, Redwood Inference
